question: Rukmini Devi Arundale won various accolades in which dance form?
solution:
The correct answer is __Bharatnatyam__.

__
 
• Rukmini Devi Arundale is associated with Bharatnatyam.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Rukmini Devi Arundale was an Indian classical dancer who led the renaissance of the ‘Bharatnatyam’ dance form and founded the Kalakshetra Foundation in Madras (now Chennai).
 
• She was also a theosophist who was greatly inspired by Annie Besant.
 
• She founded the Kalakshetra Foundation in Madras (now Chennai).
